mappingNote: Each task's iteration is its milestone in the Linear project. The iterations of a workstream combine the dashboard proposal with the milestones of the workstream's tasks.
scheduleNote: Gate dates are proposals on the Linear iteration milestones. The bands connect successive gates; they do not specify task start dates.

iterations.title: Design and measurement
iterations.delivery: The design record, the evidence, the plan.
iterations.demo: Review the design record, measurements, and implementation plan.
deliverables: The design record.
The evidence: the layout spike, the differential harness, and the catalog prototype.
The plan.
iterations.gate: The design and measurement work is complete.

iterations.title: End-to-end skeleton
iterations.delivery: Writer, bulk ingestion, catalog, SDK, one check against Census 1.
iterations.demo: Run one SDK query end to end and compare its result with Census 1 on one dataset.
deliverables: The census dataset writer (PR #2, merged).
Bulk ingestion: the reconciliation job on HealthOmics (PR #2, merged). One run converted 100 datasets in one hour of wall time and produced 96 stores.
The catalog: the Iteration 1 catalog builder and the exclusion rule (PR #4, merged 2026-09-29).
The SDK skeleton: one query over the 96 stores returns one AnnData (PR #4, merged 2026-09-29).
One check against Census 1: one dataset, 4,778 cells, zero of 9,424,345 nonzeros differ.
iterations.gate: One query runs through the system and matches Census 1 on the dataset under comparison.
notes: Iteration 1 is complete. The team confirmed the gate on 2026-09-30.
PR #2 and PR #4 are merged, and tracker task 6.1 is Done.
Harmonization is a stub. A multi-store query returns the obs columns that every selected store holds. Iteration 2 replaces the stub.

iterations.title: Full harmonization
iterations.delivery: Stores that match Census 1 cell for cell and value for value, and the obs columns a store keeps (perturbation fields included).
iterations.demo: Show Census 1 parity on the current store set, cell for cell and value for value.
deliverables: Stores that match Census 1 cell for cell and value for value.
The obs columns a store keeps, the perturbation fields included.
The harness query corpus run through the SDK against Census 1 (task 6.2). Its findings are the harmonization worklist, and an empty list is the gate.
iterations.gate: The harness reports no difference against Census 1 on the current store set.
notes: Built so far: the gene projection module (task 4.2, PR #7 in review) and the harness pieces ported to census2-sdk (PR #10, draft).
Task 6.2, the harness run through the SDK, is tracker task AIP-214.
Corpus v1.1 (tasks 2.1, 2.2) repins two vacuous queries and regenerates the oracle snapshot.

iterations.title: Scale and layout
iterations.delivery: Preview-ready: the full corpus, the store layout decided, the release builder.
iterations.demo: Query the full corpus through the catalog and SDK in a development bucket.
deliverables: The full corpus, readable through the catalog and the SDK in a development bucket.
The store layout decided, the X encoding included.
The release builder.
Scale measurements from the benchmark rig: data volume, request count, elapsed time, and concurrency for the wide filters.
iterations.gate: The full corpus is readable through the catalog and SDK in a development bucket.
notes: Built so far: the layout measurements and the backfill inventory.
The X encoding decision is with scverse.
The preview has no production sign-off.

iterations.title: Continuous ingestion and private data
iterations.delivery: The curation pipeline step, private catalogs, the filter interface over the kept obs columns, a beta on the preview.
iterations.demo: Show continuous ingestion and query public and authorized private data together.
deliverables: The curation pipeline step, on Step Functions.
Private catalogs, queried together with public data in one call.
The filter interface over the kept obs columns.
A beta on the preview.
iterations.gate: The system supports continuous ingestion and public and private sources in one query.
notes: Nothing is built yet. The design exists.
Where the writer runs in production and artifact registration in Discover are open decisions.
The curation pipeline step brings monitoring and alerting.

iterations.title: Approvals and first release
iterations.delivery: Sign-off, identity mapping, retention agreement, the SDK published with documentation, first release.
iterations.demo: Publish the first release and documented SDK after the required approvals and agreements.
deliverables: Formal sign-off on the design decisions.
The identity mapping from soma_joinid to (dataset_id, observation_joinid), derived from the last TileDB release.
The retention agreement with the bucket owners.
The SDK published with documentation and a migration guide.
The first release: a manifest over immutable stores plus a catalog snapshot.
iterations.gate: The release and SDK are published after the required approvals and agreements.
notes: Retention, Discover registration, design sign-off, and the store format need agreements outside the team. None has an owner yet.
Broader ecosystem migration continues after the first release.

iterations.title: After the first release
iterations.demo: R, spatial support, ecosystem migration, optional compaction, and cutover; no target date yet.
deliverables: The R client, once the R stack reads sharded Zarr.
Spatial: the SpatialData representation with scenes and images. The expression data of spatial datasets is in the first release, as in Census 1.
Compaction, optional, when wide-query cost calls for it.
Cutover: retirement of the TileDB corpus and the 1.x package, inside the five-year commitment.
iterations.gate: Each deferred workstream has its own completion condition in the plan.
notes: The outline assigns no date. Cutover follows the first release and R reading Zarr, and the last TileDB release stays supported until November 2030.
Built so far: one failed R read test.
